title: 拉满的石
cover_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished landscape 4:3 Toy GAME cover for a Minecraft-inspired slingshot puzzle game named exactly "拉满的石". This is the game cover, NOT a video thumbnail or mockup. Use a cohesive carefully crafted voxel/pixel-art promotional illustration with crisp square texture pixels, warm oak wood and cobblestone, bright blue daytime sky and soft white block clouds, distant grassy block hills faded with atmospheric perspective.
Input reference is ONLY the wooden slingshot silhouette and material design: honey-gold curved Y-shaped frame, brown leather wraps near the two tips, dark brown twin elastic bands. Do not copy the old cover or old title. 
Composition: a beautiful NORMAL Minecraft village cottage on the right, oak plank walls, vertical oak log corner posts, modest symmetrical stair-block pitched oak roof, cobblestone foundation, centered wooden door with small glass windows, coherent believable house proportions and intact architecture. The slingshot is large in the left foreground, bottom of its handle buried in grass and hidden by soil, visibly fully drawn with a SINGLE gray cobblestone in a brown leather pouch pulled toward lower left; BOTH bands terminate exactly on the INNER-facing sides of the two wrapped fork tips. The bands must be tensioned and physically connected; the weapon aims toward the house. Keep roof and fork tips visible around the title. Simple uncluttered grassy terrain and subtle distant hills. No characters necessary.
Typography is essential: place exactly FOUR large Chinese characters "拉满的石" centered across the middle of the image in ONE line, Minecraft-inspired square block pixel lettering, thick light gray stone faces, dark gray beveled/extruded block sides and dark shadow, professional perfectly legible Chinese letter construction, strong contrast. Exact characters in order: 拉 满 的 石. All four equally prominent. Text occupies approximately middle 60% width and is integral to the cover composition, with a little breathing room. No English, no subtitles, no additional text, no watermark, no UI, no inventory bar, no decorative border, no explosions. Finished publishable art, attractive at small thumbnail size. Output landscape 4:3, around 1600x1200.
icon_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished square app/game icon for Chinese Toy game "拉满的石", a Minecraft-inspired slingshot game. Generate ONE single clean square icon image, 1:1, approximately 1024x1024, no contact sheet.
Input image reference is ONLY the golden oak Y-shaped slingshot frame design and leather bindings. Create a visually polished chunky voxel/pixel-art illustration, recognizable at 64px. Primary subject: ONE large honey-gold wooden Y-shaped slingshot, full fork visible, both tips wrapped in reddish brown leather. It is fully drawn, holding exactly ONE gray Minecraft cobblestone block in a brown leather pouch pulled back toward the viewer and slightly left. Show the cobblestone prominently near the middle, the two taut brown elastic bands clearly connecting the pouch to the TWO INNER faces of the wrapped fork tips, one band to each tip, no floating attachments. Use a pleasing three-quarter view with clearly readable fork silhouette and believable single slingshot geometry. The slingshot and cobblestone occupy 80 percent of the image, large clear silhouette, strong simple composition and readable highlights. Both fork tips comfortably inside the frame; lower handle may exit at bottom.
Background is simple bright sky blue with one small soft block cloud and a little Minecraft grass-block ground at the bottom, minimal detail, coherent with a friendly daytime Minecraft house cover. Warm wood, cool gray stone, blue sky and green grass, crisp pixels, subtle 3D voxel shading. Subtle dark contour for small-size contrast. No house, no people, no fire, no explosions, no action swooshes, no glowing fantasy magic, no bows or arrows, no text or letters, no numbers, no watermark, no badge, no decorative outer border, no premade rounded-square container. Full bleed opaque square background. This should feel like a distinctive real game icon, not a scene screenshot and not a vector placeholder.
